description: One postgres commit from the code-history index: message, parsed trailers (names only), Discussion threads (links to the archived thread on /m/), back-patch siblings on other branches, first_releases (per branch the change landed on: sha, release such as 14.23, first_version incl. betas, shipped=false when reverted before that release; null release = not yet released), reverted_by and reverts, posted_patch (of the patch mails on its Discussion threads up to its commit date, the one whose changed lines match the commit's best: message_id, date, subject, from, score 0-1, url; null when none shares at least 0.2), files changed with line counts, and its diff rendered from the index (at most 3000 lines; diff_complete says whether it was cut). Accepts a SHA (7+ hex), branch, tag or any version form.

commit.description: SHA or prefix (7+ hex), or any version form (REL_17_0, master~2), or a commit URL (gitweb, git.postgresql.org, GitHub, pg.ddx.io)

paths.description: Only diff files under these paths

repository.description: Repository; only postgres is in the code-history index for now (the default).

name: get_commit
